description: This file is a test client for the RemoteActionMapping plugin API. It includes code to interact with the plugin via JSONRPC, handle user input to invoke various API methods, and manage remote IR key data for different devices. The code also demonstrates event subscription, usage of IR code data arrays, and auxiliary functions for data formatting and command handling.

methods.name: showMenu
methods.description: Displays the interactive menu options for testing the API methods.

methods.name: formatForDisplay
methods.description: Formats a string containing JSON-like array data into an indented, human-readable format.

methods.name: removeJsonQuotes
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes and escapes internal quotes for JSON string output.

methods.name: strcicmp
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two C strings.

methods.name: setCurrentTVData
methods.description: Sets the current TV IR data array based on the selected TV device index.

methods.name: setCurrentAVRData
methods.description: Sets the current AVR IR data array based on the selected AVR device index.

methods.name: handleParams
methods.description: Handles user input commands to modify internal parameters such as device IDs, device types, and codes.
